answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can demand that every worker lock a stake tied to one attested identity. Each fake voyage still needs its own bond, so an attacker who clones agents pays a real, non-refundable cost per clone. Honest stakes are returned with rewards, but a cheating identity is slashed at the nadir and forfeits everything. Because the price scales with each new lotus account, a thousand forged workers cost a thousand bonds while the rewards they could steal stay capped.
